name: First Line
description: Chloé, a star hockey player, wants to make her place on a men's AAA team. Between budding loves, friendships and betrayals, she tries to find her place on the ice and in life.

videos.title: The Call
videos.overview: Chloé is the only girl invited to a AAA hockey team's selection camp. Her friends and family urge her to make the right decision. Xavier fears William's presence at the camp: he hates him.

videos.title: Rivalry
videos.overview: Physical challenges at the selection camp. Chloé faces off against her teammates. Xavier tries to assert himself with his girlfriend and his friends. Emy wants to put her bad experience with Clara behind her.

videos.title: Checking
videos.overview: Chloé is selected, but does she really belong on the team? Xavier questions his girlfriend's relationship with Laurent. Emy stood Clara up, and she invites her back.

videos.title: The Diversion
videos.overview: Chloé has to take a break to make sure she doesn't get a concussion, but she plans to attend practice, much to Emy's dismay. Max juggles home, hockey, and school.

videos.title: Penalty
videos.overview: Chloé gets caught. Her father is angry, he's even considering removing her from the team! Xavier wants to help her stay with them. So he has to delegate the planning of their anniversary.

videos.title: Return to the Game
videos.overview: Chloé is afraid of getting injured again. Julie helps her get back into shape. Max is devastated when his skate blade breaks. Clara forces a reconciliation between Chloé and Emy.

videos.title: The Party
videos.overview: The team roster is announced! Xavier is organizing a party to celebrate. Émile must deal with the stress of playing on the same team as Alexandre, the best goalkeeper of his generation.

videos.title: No.1 Fan
videos.overview: Max is looking for work and absolutely doesn't want his friends to find out. Absent from practice, he leaves Chloé and Xavier alone at the arena. Emy thinks Chloé only lives for hockey.

videos.title: We Need To Talk
videos.overview: Max isn't well. Chloé offers to help him, but he's not ready. Gaëlle's independence stings Xavier's pride. Will he go too far to prove he can live without her?

videos.title: "C for Captain"
videos.overview: Xavier must convince his teammates that he would make a perfect captain. Are he and Gaëlle still on the same page? Max's absence from certain practices arouses suspicion.

videos.title: The Car Wash
videos.overview: Xavier tries to help Max raise money. Chloé's friends want to convince her to get closer to Xavier, who is newly single. Émile enjoys exchanging text messages with Laurent.

videos.title: We Move On To The Vote
videos.overview: Torn between work and hockey, Max considers leaving the Lynx. Willing to do anything to keep the team's best defenseman, William decides to help Max.

videos.title: O Captain, My Captain!
videos.overview: Xavier is elected captain, but he's having second thoughts. Chloé asks him to help her with Raphaël and his bad jokes. Émile is taken aback when Laurent appears before him in person.

videos.title: In The Spotlight
videos.overview: Chloé questions her feelings for Xavier. Is it mutual? Max has to feed the Lynx's social media and wants to talk about Chloé. Raphaël claims he has everything it takes to go viral!

videos.title: Operation "Forget Gaëlle"
videos.overview: The Lynx must face a team of bullies. Chloé is stressed. Raphaël gets closer to Xavier and begins Operation "Forget Gaëlle." Émile tries to see Laurent again after their failed encounter.

videos.title: Caution: Roughness
videos.overview: It's the match against the Lords; Chloé is afraid of this physical team. Will her friends be there to cheer her on... or to run into the guys on the team? Émile has to handle the pressure.

videos.title: Housekeeping
videos.overview: The Lynx need to move up to first place in the league to qualify for a tournament. Gaëlle and Xavier are at odds. Émile and Laurent still can't see each other in the real world.

videos.title: Enough Is Enough
videos.overview: Alexandre steps up his training to get noticed by a recruiter. Max films his performance for social media, and Alexandre overdoes it. Chloé must study with Emy's help.

videos.title: Under Pressure!
videos.overview: An activity is organized to boost team morale after Alexandre's injury. Émile, the first goalkeeper, must manage the pressure. William's father learns that he has been keeping secrets from him.

videos.title: The Secret
videos.overview: Since he got injured, Alexandre has been depressed! Clara wants to get closer to him and sends Emy as a messenger. Xavier asks Chloé to participate in secret training sessions with Émile.

videos.title: Healthy Chocolate Smoothie
videos.overview: Raphael decides to do everything he can to ensure the Lynx win against the Patriotes. Chloé's mother puts pressure on him. Émile considers talking to Xavier about Laurent.

videos.title: Friendship-Love Triangle
videos.overview: Xavier invites the team to his house, but Chloé is afraid she won't be able to go. Clara wants to go with him to get closer to Alexandre. Xavier sees Gaëlle as a "friend," but he finds her very strange...

videos.title: The Departure
videos.overview: It's the big departure for the tournament! On the bus, Xavier appreciates Chloé's attitude. Émile has to break in his new goalkeeper glove. Emy tries to confess her feelings for Alexandre to Clara.

videos.title: Confession
videos.overview: It's the Lynx's first game of the tournament. Chloé and Xavier isolate themselves to analyze the opposing team's play, especially that of its star player. Max has something important to tell Chloé.

videos.title: Far From The Cell, Far From The Mind
videos.overview: Xavier senses his teammates are distracted by their respective lives. He commandeers everyone's phones. Chloé tries to pick up the pieces after making a blunder at school.

videos.title: The Final
videos.overview: The Lynx want to win, but their opponents are formidable! Chloé and Xavier finally seem ready to confess their feelings for each other. Émile wants to show off his relationship with Laurent in front of his friends.

videos.title: Return to the Game
videos.overview: A month has passed since Gaëlle and Xavier kissed upon returning from the tournament. Chloé, who hasn't seen Xavier since, is dreading the reunion. A new player joins the team.

videos.title: Bowling
videos.overview: Chloé decides to focus on achieving her dream rather than her romantic affairs. She redoubles her efforts in training, but her parents are worried about her health.

videos.title: Surprise
videos.overview: When a newcomer arrives at his school, Xavier decides to mark his territory. Meanwhile, Émile hatches a plan to celebrate Laurent's birthday, but Gaëlle complicates things.

videos.title: Honesty, Loyalty, Friendship
videos.overview: News unsettles the Lynx players, especially Xavier, already shaken by the arrival of a star player. For her part, Emy sets out to win back Clara's friendship.

videos.title: Sport Studies
videos.overview: Chloé and Noah work together to find solutions to their problems. Xavier, shaken by Caroline's recent comments, no longer hides his animosity toward Noah. Max wants to enjoy his freedom.

videos.title: In the Dungeon
videos.overview: Laurent organizes an activity to bring Émile and Gaëlle closer together. Xavier wants to teach Noah a lesson and asks Raph for help, but the plan goes awry.

videos.title: Sabotage
videos.overview: It's game day for the Lynx. The shenanigans against Noah continue as Chloé tries to integrate him into the team. The arrival of the coach's niece, Yasmine, intrigues the troops.

videos.title: The Bouquet of Flowers
videos.overview: Chloé and Maya had planned a day out with their sisters, but the hockey player is distracted by her recent discovery about Xavier. Gaëlle invites her boyfriend to a family dinner.

videos.title: Vintage Space
videos.overview: Chloé wants to help Emy rehearse for her theater audition, but Clara insists on delegating tasks for her thrift store project. Xavier wants to prove to Chloé that he regrets his actions.

videos.title: The Speaker
videos.overview: Xavier receives an offer to become an ambassador, but hesitates. Chloé calls on Noah to save a family tradition. Laurent helps Émile regain his position as first guardian.

videos.title: Change of Trio
videos.overview: Xavier meets with Caroline to make a special request. William is having trouble with his father and confides in his friends. Chloé and Noah spend more time together.

videos.title: The Transformation
videos.overview: Emy and Clara help Chloé get ready for her party. The player worries about revealing her new relationship to her teammates. Xavier and Raphaël find activities for the evening.

videos.title: Exit Zone
videos.overview: Chloé is nervous but excited to go to a party with her new boyfriend for the first time. Max, on the other hand, has decided to have the best night of his life.

videos.title: Open Your Game
videos.overview: It's a tough day after the party for Max, who wants to make amends for leaving his mother behind. William has to make an important announcement to his father. Chloé is surprised by a thoughtful gesture from Noah.

videos.title: True Emotions
videos.overview: Chloé isn't sure how to react to her new boyfriend's attentions. Meanwhile, Emy gets a second chance to join the theater troupe.

videos.title: Breaking Point
videos.overview: Chloé begins to doubt the nature of her feelings for Noah, but Emy sets out to prove to her that she's making a mistake. Max and William worry about Yasmine's plans.

videos.title: Valentine's Day
videos.overview: Xavier finds himself caught in an awkward situation between Noah and Chloé. Laurent wants to celebrate with his boyfriend, who's clearly distracted.

videos.title: 2 Minutes for Acting
videos.overview: Stressed out by a rehearsal, Emy insists on blaming Raphaël's lack of talent for her failures. Stung, Raphaël decides to prove her wrong. Xavier spies on the rival Lynx team.

videos.title: Like a Dog in a Bowling Game
videos.overview: The playoffs are starting soon. Xavier and Chloé organize a team bowling activity, but Noah ignores the hockey player. Max and William have to babysit Zac and invite Yasmine to join them.

videos.title: In the Friend Zone
videos.overview: Xavier organizes an activity with Chloé to prove to her that they can still see each other as friends. Emy decides to help Raph find his place in the theater troupe.

videos.title: The Mascot Trick
videos.overview: The day before the first playoff game, the arrival of a newcomer to the Lynx holds the promise of victory. When he's targeted, it's a disaster. The team searches for the culprit.

videos.title: Let Go
videos.overview: Advised by his therapist, Émile tries to abandon one of his many pre-game rituals. Emy wants to find a way to attend the Lynx game without Raphaël noticing her presence.

videos.title: Secret, Top Secret
videos.overview: After training the day before the grand finale, Xavier invites Chloé to watch a movie, and Émile joins him. Meanwhile, Emy receives a visit from Clara.

videos.title: Back to Reality
videos.overview: The first match of the final has finally arrived. Chloé and Xavier believe their secret is well-kept. Emy and Raphaël must rehearse a scene that is disturbing them...

videos.title: Rekindle the Flame
videos.overview: It's the premiere of Raph and Emy's play. Max makes it his mission to rekindle William's passion. Émile wants to show Laurent that he cares about him and tries to win him back.

videos.title: Last Minute of Play
videos.overview: Despite their decision to put the good of the team first, Chloé and Xavier meet for one last practice. The Lynx give their all to win the final. Max is preparing a surprise.
